snippet.title: KoF XIII: Mr. Karate combo video (FINAL VERSION)
snippet.description:

Follow me on Twitter! http://www.twitter.com/fighterscafe
If you liked the video please remember to leave a rating - it helps me out a lot.

---

The King of Fighters XIII combo video showcasing what Mr. Karate is capable of, be that old, new, practical or impractical.

-COMMENTS-

Mr. Karate can dish out very solid damage considering that most of his specials all do the same amount of damage so you're quite free to pull off free style combos and still make the opponent suffer. Just like Takuma, ending his HD mode combos with his EX super does more damage than his Neo Max since you can easily get around 250 damage after HD mode is finished. If you're a Mr. Karate veteran, you might notice that I was able to pull off some odd loops that normally isn't possible. The answer is simple and that many of the air hcf Bs in the video are performed from a backstep giving you extra frames to perform other attacks afterwards that a tigerknee air hcf B could not achieve. Personally I find doing the backstep hcf K much more difficult than other backstep air specials in the game because you have to be accurate with your timing unlike other air specials like the Benimaru infinite where you have more frames to mess up in case you're not doing it quickly enough.

---

-NOTES-

01) Billy: Aims for most damage starting with two drive gauges.

02) Raiden: Aims for most damage with one power gauge.

03) Hwa: Aims for most damage without HD mode.

04) Kim: Aims for most damage with HD mode and two power gauges.

05) Mai: Aims for most damage with HD mode and three power gauges.

06) Joe: -

07) Andy: -

08) Terry: -

09) King: -

10) Yuri: -

11) Robert: -

12) Ryo: -

---

-TRANSCRIPT-

01) Billy: jp C, D, C xx f B xx qcf C xx dash, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, backstep hcf B, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, backstep hcf B, qcf-hcb A

02) Raiden: jp C, D, C xx f B xx qcf C xx dash, qcf-hcb A

03) Hwa: jp C, C xx f B xx dp C xx AB, jp hcf BD, jp hcf BD, jp hcf BD, jp hcf BD, qcf A, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, fbf P, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, fbf P, qcf-hcb AC

04) Kim: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx f B xx qcf C xx dash, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, backstep hcf B, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, backstep hcf B, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, qcf A xx dp C xx AB, qcf C xx dash, fbf P, qcf-hcb AC

05) Mai: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx f B xx qcf C xx dash, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, backstep hcf B, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, backstep hcf B, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, qcf A xx fbf AC, qcf A, fbf P, qcf-hcb AC

06) Joe: jp D, D, C xx f B xx BC, C xx f B xx fbf AC xx dp A (whiff), dp A xx qcf A, dp AC (1 hit) xx qcf C xx dash, qcf A xx fbf AC xx dp C, fbf P, qcf-hcb AC

07) Andy: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx dp AC xx hcf BD, qcfx2 K (1 hit), dp AC xx hcf B, qcf C xx fbf P xx dp A xx hcf B, qcf C xx dash, fbf P, qcfx2 K

08) Terry: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx dp AC xx hcf B, dp A xx hcf B, backstep hcf B, qcf A xx dp C xx AB, jp hcf B, qcf A xx dp C xx AB, jp hcf B, qcf A xx fbf AC, jp hcf B, fbf P, qcf-hcb AC

09) King: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx dp AC xx hcf BD, qcf A xx dp C xx AB, jp hcf B, qcf A xx dp C xx AB, jp hcf B, qcf A xx dp C xx AB, qcf C xx fbf AC, qcf C xx dash, fbf P, qcf-hcb AC

10) Yuri: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx jp hcf B, dp AC xx hcf D (whiff), qcf C xx dash, qcf A, dp A xx qcf AC, jp hcf B, qcf A xx dp C xx AB,

11) Robert: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx dp AC xx hcf D (1 hit), qcf A xx dp A, dp A, dp A xx hcf B, qcf C xx dash, dp A xx hcf B, qcf C xx fbf AC, backstep hcf B, backstep hcf BD, fbf P, qcf-hcb AC

12) Ryo: jp C, D, C xx f B xx BC, D, C xx dp AC xx hcf B, dp AC xx hcf D (whiff), backstep hcf B, backstep hcf B, qcf A xx dp C xx AB, fbf P, qcfx2 K (2 hits) xx qcb-hcf AC
